notes: Sanctum of All. Printed: 'you may search your library and/or graveyard for A Shrine card and put it onto the battlefield.' At turn 3's upkeep seat 0 fires the may and searches its graveyard only (option 2) with two Shrines in it: exactly one (Shrine A, its choice) is put onto the battlefield, never two; Shrine B stays in the graveyard.
